text:
Jess Carter: Heads up — VentureGrid QBR prep. Token runway looks tighter than we thought; need a quick cost play before Tuesday.
Ryan Liu: Can you drop the latest burn numbers?
Jess Carter: Sure, pasted from billing-scraper:
```
tokens_used_last_30d: 3,210,450
monthly_commit: 5,000,000
runway_at_current_rate: 1.6 months
forecast_next_90d (with embed pilot): 9,820,000
surge_scenarios: +40% (model change) / +80% (feature flag)
```
Olivia Kim: We already auto-flagged at 80% commit. Created billing alert BG-452 and emailed AMs. Link: https://console.redwood/billing/alerts/BG-452
Tom Rivera: Noted — looks like a lot of unbatched embed calls from their ingestion worker. We should turn on prefix/KV caching and suggest a quantized model variant for ingestion paths.
Ryan Liu: Which model quant profiles give biggest ROI? need rough delta.
Tom Rivera: Quick numbers from bench:
- rw-instruct-13b: baseline
- rw-instruct-13b-q8: ~2.4x throughput, ~35% token cost reduction for steady streams
- rw-compute-7b-q4: ~3.1x throughput for embed-heavy, but slightly lower quality for long instructs
Olivia Kim: If they accept a 30% cost reduction proposal we can stretch runway to ~2.1 months and avoid commit top-up. Want me to prod finance for a short-term discount?
Jess Carter: Yes — please ask for a one-off 10% credits adjustment tied to enablement milestones.
OnboardBot: Scheduled enablement + cost workshop with VentureGrid for 2026-04-08 16:00 UTC — calendar invite sent: https://calendar.link/xYz
Ryan Liu: Action items:
- Tom: enable prefix caching + recommend rw-instruct-13b-q8 on staging (by EOD)
- Olivia: open discount ask with finance & prepare 2-pager (by tomorrow)
- Jess: own customer call and run cost scenarios during enablement
Jess Carter: I'll run the deck and a short demo of batching + caching. :thumbsup:
Olivia Kim: +1. I'll also wire sample prompts to test quality delta.
Ryan Liu: If the customer won't accept model change, fallback plan is temporary token cap + rate-limit policy on ingestion service.
Tom Rivera: I'll also add a temporary route-level throttle rule we can flip from console.
Jess Carter: Thanks team — moving this to pre-QBR checklist. Will update here after enablement.
